title: eval-receipt-row
description: One eval receipt row (SCOPE.md §4, B18-1 as amended by the S0 gate review). Append-only JSONL; writes are atomic (temp+rename) with a completeness marker; evolution is additive-only. exclusion_reason is MANDATORY (non-null) iff result=excluded, and MUST be null otherwise.

schema_version.description: Version of this row shape (all v1 rows carry schema_version; evolution is additive-only).

run_id.description: References run-ledger.run_id — the join key linking this receipt to its run-ledger row (S0 fold: verify pass rate is read via run_id joins between ledger and receipts).

pack.description: Eval pack this receipt belongs to.

case_id.description: Case within the pack that was evaluated.

check.description: The specific check the case ran.

exclusion_reason.description: MANDATORY (non-null, non-empty) iff result=excluded; MUST be null otherwise. Enforced by the if/then/else conditional below.

receipt_ref.description: Reference to the receipt evidence artifact.
